transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Cardholder Services. My name is Marcus. May I have your name, please?
Customer: Hi Marcus, yes, my name is Abigail Treadway.
Agent: Hello Ms. Treadway. To verify your account, could you please provide your billing zip code and the last four digits of your card?
Customer: Sure, the zip code is 43215, and the last four digits are 8841.
Agent: Thank you. What can I help you with today?
Customer: I was looking at my statement that came out on October 2nd, which was about thirteen days ago, and there is a charge that looks completely wrong.
Agent: I can certainly look into that with you. Which transaction are you referring to?
Customer: It is from StreamNest Plus back on September 22nd. The total is $119.88, which makes no sense because their service is only around ten dollars.
Agent: I see that charge on September 22nd for $119.88. Did you recently set up or renew an account with StreamNest Plus?
Customer: Well, I did sign up for their streaming service around that week because there was a new show I wanted to watch, but I only wanted the regular monthly subscription.
Agent: Do you recall receiving an email confirmation or receipt from them when you completed the sign-up?
Customer: Let me pull up my email on my tablet right now. I know I got a welcome message from them.
Agent: Take your time, please let me know what it shows.
Customer: Okay, looking at the welcome email from September 22nd... wait a minute.
Agent: What does the email say?
Customer: Oh goodness, I feel so silly. It says, "Thank you for choosing the annual membership." There was a promotion to pay for the whole year upfront to save money, and I totally forgot that I clicked that box instead of the monthly one.
Agent: So looking at the confirmation, it reflects the yearly plan of $119.88 that you selected during sign-up.
Customer: Yes, exactly. I completely blanked on that and thought they had charged me twelve months all at once by mistake, but I actually picked it myself.
Agent: So to make sure I have all the details correct, you noticed the $119.88 charge from StreamNest Plus on your October 2nd statement, and after checking your sign-up receipt, you confirmed you had chosen their annual subscription option yourself on September 22nd.
